description: Interrupt yourself on your own devices — a phone, a laptop — with the page closed. For the thing that cannot wait until the next time somebody looks. An answer to a question belongs in the thread it was asked in, not here

body.description: A second line, up to about 300 characters. Optional

title.description: The line on the lock screen. Short — this is the whole message on a watch

url.description: Where tapping it goes, e.g. /inbox. A notification you cannot act on trains someone to ignore the next one

name: notify_send
title: Send notify
